dialogue.name: RUNNER
dialogue.text: I told you that the pants would fit you, Sorter.

dialogue.name: SORTER
dialogue.text: I'm, uh, more preoccupied with what Commander has.

dialogue.name: SORTER
dialogue.text: Its circular shape and indented grooves suggest that it's probably a vinyl record.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Sorter, can you decipher the record?

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Long without contact, and they send us... tunes?

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Are they expecting a response? Can we replicate this?

dialogue.name: LIFTER
dialogue.text: I mean, this doesn't seem too hard. Just keep things on beat, yeah?

dialogue.name: RUNNER
dialogue.text: Oh! And then maybe we could even start making our own music and vinyls.

dialogue.name: RUNNER
dialogue.text: If you think that's advisable, Commander...

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Lifter, make a holo-copy of yourself.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Once you're done, everybody set up and start feeling the music!
